li.label: worked to the bone
li.description: The council has us working from dawn until we drop. I hate every minute.

li.label: long hours
li.description: Up early, to bed late, and the work never ends. The council says it's temporary.

li.label: honest hard work
li.description: Finally the whole colony is pulling its weight.

li.label: a colony that works
li.description: This is how it should always be.

li.label: starving on rations
li.description: Half a bowl of mush and a pat on the back. I think about food all day.

li.label: on rations
li.description: The portions have shrunk. My belt has new holes.

li.label: sensible rations
li.description: Eating less is wise. We'll be glad of it in winter.

li.label: living lean
li.description: Hunger sharpens the mind.

li.label: endless drills
li.description: Marching, shooting, shouting. I'm not a soldier, and I hate pretending.

li.label: drills
li.description: Weapons practice every day. My arms ache and my ears ring.

li.label: good training
li.description: We're getting sharper. I can feel it.

li.label: battle drills!
li.description: Every day is a fight now. Practice ones, sadly. Still.

li.label: stuck in lessons
li.description: Sitting still, listening to lectures, when there's real work to do. Torture.

li.label: study hours
li.description: Lessons every evening. My head is full and my back is stiff.

li.label: learning together
li.description: Everyone is learning something. It's good to see.

li.label: a colony of scholars
li.description: Finally, people around here are using their heads.

li.label: austerity
li.description: We're not even allowed to ask for things now. What's the point of any of this?

li.label: tightened belts
li.description: The council isn't taking requests. We make do.

li.label: living simply
li.description: Fewer wants, fewer worries.

li.label: blessed simplicity
li.description: At last everyone lives the way I always have.

li.label: wasted festival days
li.description: Everyone is lazing about while the work piles up. It makes my skin crawl.

li.label: idle festival
li.description: Nobody is working. I can't relax knowing that.

li.label: festival days
li.description: Music, rest and late nights. We needed this.

li.label: best festival ever
li.description: No work, all play. If only it could last forever.

li.label: the council heeded me
li.description: I asked for a decree, and the council actually declared it.
